title: Anti advertisement
description:
Made by @zorowarrior7
Server Anti Advertise is a security plugin that prevents players from advertising other servers in chat. The plugin automatically detects server IPs, domains, and common advertisement formats and blocks them instantly.
body:
🛡️ The ultimate anti‑ad protection for your Minecraft server
Automatically detect and block server IPs, domains, and advertising phrases before they reach chat — then punish offenders with a full manual and automatic moderation toolkit.

⚡ Why choose AntiServerAdvertisement?

Smart Detection – catches IPs, domains, and custom regex patterns in chat, signs, books, and commands
Auto‑Punishment Ladder – warn → kick → mute → tempban → ban → ipban (fully configurable thresholds)
Full Moderation Suite – manual commands for /warn, /kick, /mute, /unmute, /freeze, /unfreeze, /tempban, /ban, /ipban, and more
Freeze System – instantly lock a player in place for investigation
Mute System – mutes chat while still allowing detection of further ad attempts
Staff Notifications – notify online staff when an ad is blocked
Player Reporting – let your community report suspected advertisers
Exemptions & Tolerance – whitelist VIPs/staff or adjust strictness per player
Fully Configurable – every message, threshold, and action can be customized
Cross‑Version – works flawlessly on 1.20.x, 1.21.x, and 1.26.x
